svg.text: HCMC headquarters - links, interface IDs, VLANs and the L2/L3 boundary
WAN edge (L3): NAT overload, zone firewall, IPsec hub, eBGP + iBGP route-reflector
Collapsed core (L2/L3 boundary): HSRPv2 gateways, RSTP roots, ACL segmentation, OSPF/OSPFv3 area 0
Access (L2 only): DHCP snooping, DAI, port security, BPDU guard, storm control
